1 رَفَسهُ , (S, M, Msb, K, *) or رَفَسَهُ بِرِجْلِهِ, (M,) aor.
رَفِسَ (S, M, Msb, K) and
رَفُسَ , (M, K,) inf. n. رَفْسٌ (S, M, &c.) and رِفَاسٌ, (Jm, K,) or this is a simple subst., (M,) and رُفَاسٌ, (Jm,) [or this also is a simple subst.,] He kicked him, or struck him with his foot or leg, (S, M, Msb, K, *) in an absolute sense, (M, Msb,) or in, or upon, the breast. (Kh, M, Msb.) ―
-b2- رَفَسَهُ, inf. n. رَفْسٌ, He pounded it, or brayed it; namely, flesh-meat, or other food; or anything; but originally, food. (M, TA.) ＝
-A2- رَفَسَ البَعِيرَ, (K,) aor.
رَفُسَ , inf. n. رَفْسٌ, (TA,) He bound the camel with the رِفَاس [q. v.]. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
